column1: # More of the house's icons: the same table as `asset/icon.tsv`, which
# says how a row is read. `script/icon.py` reads every `asset/icon*.tsv`.
# --- letters, as marks: for a host or a person with no picture
# Made as the p of Phiogy is: one filled body between 4 and 20, as high
# as a small letter (7 to 19), its corners round (6) where the letter
# turns and tight (1.5) where its stem stands; a tail where the letter
# rises (to 3) or drops (to 22.5); and what is open in the letter cut
# out of it, a pill for a closed bowl, a slot for an open one. `cut` is
# a shape taken out of the fill before it, `hole` a pill taken out.
